questions.q: Which facility inaugurated by Dr. Jitendra Singh in Delhi-NCR is the world’s first to analyze air pollution composition and sources in real-time?
o: Integrated Atmospheric Chemistry and Aerosol Toxicity Analysis Laboratory (AATAL)
Centre for Air Pollution Research and Control (CAPRC)
questions.x: The facility is named **Integrated Atmospheric Chemistry and Aerosol Toxicity Analysis Laboratory (AATAL)** and was inaugurated under **Mission Mausam**.

questions.q: Under which mission was the target of creating **11 crore Farmer IDs** achieved five months ahead of schedule?
questions.x: The target was achieved under the **Digital Agriculture Mission**, implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare.

questions.q: Which scheme replaced the Mahatma Gandhi NREGA and guarantees 125 days of wage employment annually for rural households?
o: Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G)
Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana
questions.x: The VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 guarantees 125 days of wage employment annually for rural households.

questions.q: Which initiative by South Central Railway integrates drone surveillance with rapid-response teams under the SHAKTI framework?
